bind_address.description: IP address to bind to; becomes `-l <address>`.

db_dir.description: Directory for chroot and DB persistence; used in --chroot $DIR.

enable_compression.description: Enable compression. Not used directly in init script.

enable_dns_lookups.description: Enable reverse DNS lookups; becomes `-r` when true.

enable_graphing.description: Enable graphing. Not used directly in init script, but darkstat uses -g option if set.

graph_dir.description: Directory for daily graph data. Not used directly in init script, but darkstat uses -g option if set.

graph_retention_days.description: Retention days for graphs. Not used directly in init script.

interfaces.description: Interface(s) to capture from; each becomes a separate `-i <iface>` argument. Use 'any' for all interfaces.

max_hosts.description: Maximum hosts. Not used directly in init script; darkstat uses -m option if set.

max_ports.description: Maximum ports per host. Not used directly in init script.

port.description: TCP port for the web UI; becomes `-p <port>`.

start_enabled.description: Whether to set START_DARKSTAT=yes in /etc/darkstat/init.cfg (controls if darkstat starts on boot).
